fib: ______ are referred to as exports and goods bought from them as imports.
Goods sold to other countries
Goods sold to other countries are referred to as exports and goods bought from them as imports.
______ is described as persistent and appreciable increase in the general price level.
Inflation
Inflation is described as persistent and appreciable increase in the general price level.
______ are the comparison of a country‟s exports with imports.
terms of trade
The terms of trade are the comparison of a country‟s exports with imports.
______ are a reason why Conservatives want sustainable growth with a prudent fiscal policy.
Recessions
Recessions are a reason why Conservatives want sustainable growth with a prudent fiscal policy.
______ is a situation where the process of increasing price level is caused by increasing costs of production which push up prices.
Cost push or supply inflation
Cost push or supply inflation is a situation where the process of increasing price level is caused by increasing costs of production which push up prices.
______ is a leakage from the circular flow and government purchases are injections into the circular flow.
Taxation
Taxation is a leakage from the circular flow and government purchases are injections into the circular flow.
______ is the case of an undervalued currency.
Opposite
Opposite is the case of an undervalued currency.
______ are referred to as exports and goods bought from them are dubbed as imports.
Good sold to other countries
Good sold to other countries are referred to as exports and goods bought from them are dubbed as imports.
______ is a duty on an imported commodity while export tariff is a duty on an exported commodity.
import tariff
An import tariff is a duty on an imported commodity while export tariff is a duty on an exported commodity.
______ is a liquid store of value which can be invested at an opportune moment in interest bearing bonds or securities.
Money held for speculative purposes
Money held for speculative purposes is a liquid store of value which can be invested at an opportune moment in interest bearing bonds or securities.
______ is the continuous and consistence fall in general price level due to low volume of money income in circulation which lead to deficiency in demand.
Deflation
Deflation is the continuous and consistence fall in general price level due to low volume of money income in circulation which lead to deficiency in demand.
